Retry helper in Kotlin

Use exponential backoff around flaky network calls. The helper below retries up to three times.

suspend fun <T> retryIO(times: Int = 3, block: suspend () -> T): T {
    repeat(times - 1) {
        try { return block() } catch (e: IOException) { delay(500) }
    }
    return block()
}

Call it from a coroutine scope tied to the request lifecycle.
